Just ahead, she can see Chad, Carson, and Preston.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just a little faster!
At last, the three boys are only a few yards ahead of her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just need to stand my ground and shoot...
Sam stops and aims her gun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha! Eat paint!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're turning on me? After everything we've been through?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry I have to do this...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I suppose this kind of betrayal was inevitable.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We all have to make sacrifices during wartime.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's just... I thought we had something special...
Sam pulls the trigger...
And hits Zach over Nick's shoulder!
Nick glances behind him and sees Zach clutching the paintball splatter on his stomach.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sam! How could you?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: It was perfect! I was still in the game!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But you had paint on you!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I tipped over a can of paint in a supply room, so it didn't count.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Wow, this blows! I had the perfect plan!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, Zach. Sometimes we have to make sacrifices.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: When you said that, I thought you were...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Talking to you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe a little bit.
Zach trudges away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad to see the knock on the head didn't hurt him too much.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you mean what you said about us having something special?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I might have been overcome with emotion in a moment of doubt... It was purely self-preservation.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh. That's too bad... Because I had the same thought...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Must be the self-preservation talking.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Nick Brown. Let's clean up this mess.
Congratulations! You helped Sam navigate through some very tough spots, and it looks like she made a friend!
But what about the rest of the Centerscore contestants? Let's see what happened to Colt and Denni!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're turning on me? After everything we've been through?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nick. It's just... I was thinking over what Jacob and the guys were saying.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I am Centerscore. And you are Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It just wasn't meant to be.
Sam squeezes the trigger and shoots Nick!
Nick puts a hand to his stomach where yellow paint has splattered.
He looks at Sam with hurt eyes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I thought... We got along so well...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, Nick...
As Nick walks off, Zach pops up and shoots Sam!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha! For Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Zach! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You were consorting with the enemy, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And Phil said you came down with Stockholm whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: It's better I take you out now.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Just in case you turn.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Those are zombies.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Exactly!
Sam stalks out of the cabin, her chances of winning the Spartan Games falling as fast as her tears.
Looks like Sam didn't trust the right people this time around!

And keep in mind, once you pass Sam's section, you'll be able to see what happened to Colt and Denni!

nodes.text: Sam ducks!
Aimed too high, Phil's bullet whizzes over Sam's head, just as Sam's bullet takes Phil out!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry it came down to this, Phil.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Me too.
Phil's heads for the door. As he leaves, he looks at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I hope you're right about Nick.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Win this one for us.
As Phil leaves, Nick comes into the room.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I called the game judges. An evacuation team will be here in a few minutes to take care of Zach...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You look pleasantly paint-free.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just hope I'm doing the right thing.
Sam whips her pistol around and aims it at Nick Brown's head.
Sam jumps, but it doesn't matter!
Phil shoots high! His paintball hits Sam, just as Sam's hits Phil!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I'm out of the game!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: We both are...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who's going to win it for us now?
Sam freezes!
Phil's paintball hits Sam, just as Sam's hits Phil!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I'm out of the game!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: We both are...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who's going to win it for us now?
Sam enters the dining room once more, her gun ready in front of her.
When she rounds the corner, she comes face to face with Phil!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Agh!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Agh!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Phil, you scared me!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Likewise.
They both take stock of the situation. Sam and Phil point their paintball guns at one another warily.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Phil, I don't really think we want to do this.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: No, we don't.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So why don't you put your weapon down first...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Wait, why don't you go first?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We could put them down on the count of three...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Assuming you'd actually do it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, assuming `you'd` actually do it!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, assuming [color=#3b78e2][i]you'd[/i][/color] actually do it!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: My loyalty to the team isn't in question here!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Neither is mine!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Then why are you working with a Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because he's different! If he wins, he'll still take care of Centerscore. I don't mind defending him for that.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: He's really gotten to you, hasn't he? You're displaying all the classical signs of Stockholm Syndrome!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How many are there?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: One! And that's sympathy! You're defending him!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: If we can't come to a truce, it looks like we're going to have to settle this the old-fashioned way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How's that?
Phil levels his paintball gun at her at the same moment that Sam squeezes the trigger!
Nick nods.
Together, they walk quietly towards the couch, their weapons raised.
Sam and Nick are just about to look over the couch when Zach springs up!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: `Aaaaaaiiiiieeeeeee!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aaaaaaiiiiieeeeeee!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Found him!
Reflexively, Sam and Nick both shoot!
Zach ducks but hits his head on the hard back of the sofa.
He tumbles to the rug, paint covering his sleeves. He lies still on the floor at Sam's feet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! Is he okay?
Nick checks Zach over.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I think... I think he knocked himself out when he hit the sofa.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But he's breathing. That's a good sign.
Suddenly, there's a noise from down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That must be our third guest. But we should probably deal with Zach first.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Deal with him how?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: In emergencies, you can call for an outside team to evacuate people. Just let me make a quick call...
Nick gestures to a phone on a desk in the den.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure. I'll check out what that noise is.
Nick nods.
Together, they walk quietly towards the bathroom door, their weapons raised.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come out, come out, wherever you are...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'm right here, suckers!
From behind them, Zach bursts from the couch!
He charges at them like a large bull, two guns at the ready.
Paintballs fly everywhere!
Three of them hit Sam's arm, legs, and body...
One of them hits Nick in the face!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Owwww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Owwww![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! Nick!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That's right, punks! This cabin is ours now!
Sam and Nick get to their feet and sadly make their way off the grounds.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, that's too bad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. It really is.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But maybe there's hope. Maybe Centerscore has a chance of winning with these guys.
From outside, they can hear Zach hoot with joy.
The noise does nothing to comfort Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not so sure about that...
Sam freezes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, what are you doing? We should start searching the room...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: He could be anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Or right here, suckers!
From behind them, Zach bursts from the couch!
He charges at them like a large bull, two guns at the ready.
Paintballs fly everywhere!
Three of them hit Sam's arm, legs, and body...
One of them hits Nick in the face!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Owwww!`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! Nick!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That's right, punks! This cabin is ours now!
Sam and Nick get to their feet and sadly make their way off the grounds.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, that's too bad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. It really is.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But maybe there's hope. Maybe Centerscore has a chance of winning with these guys.
From outside, they can hear Zach hoot with joy.
The noise does nothing to comfort Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not so sure about that...
In the cabin's den, Sam and Nick find a window that's been jammed open.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-oh...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That can't be good.
Sam scans the room carefully. To her right is a bathroom door that's slightly ajar.
To her left is a large couch that an intruder could easily hide behind.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I wonder where he went...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shh...
She puts a finger to her lips and then points at the...
Sam shoots just as Jacob turns around, hitting him square in the chest!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What the...?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, Jacob, but it was either you or us.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: 'Us', huh?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You're sticking up for that Spartan loser?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you had listened to what I said before, you'd know that he's not all that bad!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You really like a Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I, uh... I didn't say anything like that, did I?
Jacob shakes his head and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You may have shot me, but more are coming.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We are legion!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You mean 'three'?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I said what I said.
Jacob leaves the room.
And that's when Sam and Nick hear shuffling noises from a different part of the house...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We should probably go investigate.
Sam tries to shoot him, but her clumsy grip on the handle stops her!
Jacob dives into a nearby closet before Sam can get another shot in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No!
Sam and Nick jump up and run toward the closet.
Just as they approach the door, Jacob jumps out and shoots them both!
Sam feels the pellet impact her bruised elbow before she sees its yellow hue splatter all over her clothes.
Beside her, Nick tries in vain to wipe some of the yellow paint off his black shirt.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yellow's never been my color.
Nick turns away and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why'd you shoot, Jacob?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Because you were going to shoot me.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Now if you don't mind... I believe this cabin is ours now.
Sam walks away, feeling more alone than ever.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Over here! Quick!
Sam and Nick slide behind the counter just as Jacob runs into the kitchen!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Where'd they go?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whew! Just in time!
Jacob runs just past the island...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now's my chance!
Sam pops up from behind the island and aims at Jacob's exposed back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For Centerscore!
She grabs Nick's hand.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on! To the bedroom!
They run into the closest room and hide behind the bed.
From their spot, they can hear Jacob walking through the house.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I can see the open door to the bedroom, guys...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... We probably should have closed that.
Jacob runs into the room, shooting paintballs!
Sam and Nick duck behind the bed until Sam hears Jacob stop firing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now's my chance!
Sam pops up from behind the bed and aims.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...
Nick grabs her hand.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No time! Come on! To the bedroom!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let's just say I'm not opposed to actually using the money to improve the school.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: As head of the journalism club, I could use the money to get new camera equipment, better software... Maybe even a lab!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That doesn't necessarily sound like you're servicing the public good.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, don't underestimate the value of making keepsakes. Pictures are ways of capturing our memories.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: For better or worse, they can show us who we are and how we live our lives.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They're important.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, that's...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's actually kind of sweet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it totally makes my reasons for wanting to win sound selfish.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What are your reasons?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's a little complicated...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure I can handle it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Last year, I was voted a Homecoming Princess. At first, I hated it. I didn't think I could be Queen, so I tried to back out of it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But as the voting went on, I realized more and more that it was what I wanted. And I tried very hard to become the candidate that people could look up to.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: People said that I was the princess who inspired everyone to be true to themselves... So when I didn't win, it was pretty crushing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then the Spartan Games came up, and I thought maybe this was another chance at that. My second chance to win a crown.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that totally crazy? I mean, it's a crown.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, it's what the crown represents. Proof that you really tried for something and won it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow. Okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, Nick... I've never met someone who just gets me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But with you...
Sam meets Nick's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, I...
Suddenly, they're interrupted by a loud thud at the window!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What the...?
Outside stand Jacob, Phil, and Zach, their paintball guns primed and ready.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Come out, Spartan! We know you're inside!
Warily, Nick opens the window, purposefully leaving the screen intact.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: All right. I'll bite. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: We want to win!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let me be more specific. What do you want right now?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Food.
Jacob shoulder checks Zach.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What we want is the cabin.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let me think...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Mmmmm, no. Sorry. It's taken.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And it's just so cozy here.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: If you won't come out and surrender peacefully, we'll take it by force!
Sam elbows Nick out of the way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sam? Is that you?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh no! Don't tell me you're being held prisoner!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That Spartan lowlife! We'll rescue you, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I'm not his prisoner! Nick is helping me. I don't think you should be attacking him.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What? But he's the enemy!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Wait, guys, I know what this is. It's Stockholm Syndrome!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What the heck is that?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sounds like something we need to kick that Spartan's butt for!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: It's when the person who's captured begins to feel sympathy for her captor. I read about it in a book.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: So it means we can't listen to what she's saying. She doesn't know better!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Good enough for me! Attack!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For the love of... I can't believe you guys!
Sam leaves the window.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: For Centerscore!
The boys run around the corner of the house, disappearing from view.
Inside, Nick closes the window. He goes to a chest near the door and pulls out a paint pistol and tosses it to Sam.
Sam awkwardly grips it in her left hand. She stares down at it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I should shoot him right now and get away. He's a `Spartan`.
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I should shoot him right now and get away. He's a [color=#3b78e2][i]Spartan[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But... Somehow I can't.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, I'm defending the cabin. I understand if you want to leave, but I don't advise going out right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up for a second, would you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam?
She points out another window.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're splitting up to look for an opening. They could come from anywhere, so it's better to be careful...
A thunderous crack erupts from the back of the house!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The back! It sounds like one of them broke the door off its hinges.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who's going to pay for that?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure Carson's family will manage.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do we do?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Find cover!
Sam scans their available options.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We could hide behind the kitchen island or go into the bedroom...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, let's find cover...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Historically, the winner of the Spartan Games has had better luck with the girls...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But sadly, I don't have any girls that I want to impress.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Would `you` be impressed?
nodes.text_bbcode: Would [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] be impressed?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It'd be pretty awesome.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, maybe I have a new reason to win...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But the real reason is so that I can make a difference.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That sounds really cheesy.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No. That's not what I want at all.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I've discovered that popular people aren't always that happy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: As a previously popular person, I can attest to that.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Then why'd you suggest it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It seems like a common goal.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I forgot you were uncommon.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The real reason is so that I can make a difference.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That sounds really cheesy.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I wouldn't put it like that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it's true?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yes, actually. As cheesy as that sounds.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you don't want to 'make a difference'...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How would you put it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh? What strategy is that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: My plan is to stay away from everyone else while the numbers whittle down.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Then when there's only a couple contestants left, I plan to swoop in and paint them off, thus ensuring my victory.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I've been in these games long enough to know how to keep out of everyone's way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But wait... I thought all of the Spartans were trying to help Chad win.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why are you against him?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Have you met the guy?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, yeah. He's a jerk. But you did all go to school together.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I would never team up with Chad. He's an obtuse, self-centered idiot.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: When he and Percy were in charge at Spartan, they made my life horrendous.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And I hate to think of what they'd do if they got their hands on the money from these games.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's why I'm hoping my strategy works.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why do you want to win?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Why do you think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Everything's a guessing game with you, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Answering my questions with questions, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh fine. You want to win...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh really? How do you know this isn't one big trap?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because if you had wanted to shoot me, you would have done so already.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe I'm just waiting for you to let your guard down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My guard's already down.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Look at that. Didn't shoot.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Proves my point then.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You sure I'm not just trying to take you hostage?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think you could handle me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You might be surprised...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So you believe my intentions are good?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not entirely. But... I have a good gut feeling about you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: As the journalist slash head photographer for our distinguished newspaper, I always say that it's important to follow your gut.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It tells the best stories.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But really, you don't factor into any of my grand machinations. I already have a strategy for winning.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what is it then?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You planning on waiting until I let my guard down before you shoot me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Think about it... If I hadn't wanted to shoot you, I would have done it the minute you left yourself open.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Which was every moment we've been together because you are not carrying a paintball gun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, fine. If it's not that, then are you planning on taking me hostage and using me as a pawn in your game?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Calm down. There's no grand scheme. I just want to win.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Believe what you want, but just return my favor and don't shoot me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Besides, can't a guy be selfless?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So maybe I'm starting to come around. It's just... In my experience, guys don't really know what 'being selfless' is.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh. That sounds like a tragic romantic history waiting to be explored.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, isn't it a little bit true?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know. I just saw a beautiful girl in trouble and wanted to help.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, I really screwed that one up, huh?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know. It is flattering you think I'm that much of a military strategist, so I can't really fault you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Of course I already have a winning strategy without you factoring into it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I don't get it... You're still a Spartan. You have no reason to help me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: All those things are true. And I'd love to answer your questions, but...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's dangerous out here. Why don't we talk inside?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Inside?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Inside?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm staying in the cabin up this way. Come on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think I can trust him... But maybe this cabin he has will be useful...
In the cabin, Sam sits at a table while Nick rummages around for a first aid kit.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: His back is turned... Here's my chance! I can grab his gun...
Sam shifts towards his gun which is sitting on the sofa nearby when Nick turns around.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You'd think a cabin like this would have all the amenities...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But all I can see are cappuccino machines, fancy cups, and expensive pouches of hot chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Though speaking of which... You want some?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hot chocolate? This is a paintball war, not high tea.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't hear a 'no'.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just don't poison it on your way over. We're supposed to be enemies in all this.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I wouldn't dream of it.
Nick puts some water on the stove, then continues rummaging.
Sam starts to move towards the sofa again, but stops when he glances back at her.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How is it they have a cabinet just full of gold spoons?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Almost!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: A can of foie gras, some caviar... There it is! First aid kit.
Nick sits in the chair next to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let me see your arm.
He takes her arm and begins purposefully pushing on different areas with his fingertips.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ow! Watch it!
Sam pulls her arm away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, in my expert medical opinion, I don't think it's broken.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can you have an expert medical opinion if you're not a doctor?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Touche.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I've gotten in enough scrapes of my own to know it'll be fine. Your elbow's just incredibly swollen.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You must have hit that rock really hard.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If we put on this elastic bandage and an ice pack, I think you'll survive.
He takes her arm again, this time gently winding the bandage several times around it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: There you go.
Nick puts the first aid kit back in the cupboard and mixes both of them some hot chocolate.
He hands Sam a steaming cup.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe if I get him to drop his guard... I can grab his gun and some food and get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't like flirting to get my way, but... Desperate times.
Sam smiles at Nick sweetly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for patching me up.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I rescued you. I might as well make sure the job is done properly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I'm curious... Why `are` you being so helpful?
nodes.text_bbcode: So I'm curious... Why [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] you being so helpful?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The way I see it... You're either just a really nice guy, or you have an ulterior motive.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Which do you think it is?
With her good hand, Sam fumbles for a stick and swipes it at Nick's feet.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoa there!
Sam swipes at him again, but Nick grabs the stick and tosses it away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What is going on?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You tell me, `Spartan!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You tell me, [color=#3b78e2][i]Spartan![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I might be confused, but didn't I just save you?
Sam is sobered by the thought. She drops her hands.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But look, I've been dealing with Spartans all day, and they're not above taking a cheap shot just to win.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Is it cliche to say 'I'm different'?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, actually.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am sorry. Thanks for saving me. My name is Sam.
Overcoming her baser instincts, Sam chooses not to attack him.
Her eyes never leaving Nick's, she rises slowly to her feet and circles him warily.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for rescuing me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I get why you're suspicious, but I can assure you I have no intention of harming you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm glad I didn't attack him... He seems different than the others...
Sam picks up her pace, making longer and longer strides to match them!
For one long moment, Sam thinks she might make it!
But they pull ahead!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! They're getting away!
Sam wills her legs to go faster, but she falls behind them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I can't keep up with you... But that doesn't mean I can't hit you from here!
Sam stops and aims her gun at the boys' retreating backs.
Bounding over the floor with a catlike grace, Colt neatly hops over all the obstacles and gets to the other side!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice! I'm a freaking ninja!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A handsome, devilish ninja... With an awesome motorcycle... And a hot girlfriend... And...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! Stay on target! I'm here to rescue Tom!
Colt creeps through the cafeteria, rounds a corner, and approaches the door to the office. He throws it open...)

menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: Colt rushes across the cafeteria...
And steps right on a pile of potato chips! They crunch loudly underfoot!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Aggggh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aggggh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt jumps away from the chips and trips over a chair! It clatters loudly to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Crap!
He stumbles to the side and steps right on a whoopie cushion!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh come on! Why is that even here?!
There's a commotion from down the hall, and the sound of rushing footsteps! Colt sprints through the room, stepping on a pile of dry leaves, a broken plate, and an old, squeaky bicycle horn!
He hurls himself through the door at the far end, runs around a corner, and races towards the door to the office. He throws it open...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The main hallway's gonna be blocked. My best bet is to go through the cafeteria...
Colt pries open the door and peeks inside. The floor is cluttered with overturned chairs, spilled food, and random bits of trash!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... Almost there... Just need to cross the room without making any noise...
Colt steels himself, takes a deep breath, and steps on...
Colt pulls open a locker door...
And a dozen filthy, reeking garbage bags tumble out!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Dahhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Dahhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt recoils away, gagging!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think a vagrant's been squatting here... And he loves Thai food...
Footsteps sound from down the hall! The Spartan is almost there!
Desperate, Colt dives into the foul-smelling locker and pulls the door shut!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uggghh... It's like someone ate a dumpster and then threw it back up!
The Spartan guy walks right up to the locker. He picks up one of the trashbags and examines it... Then walks off, muttering about how gross it is!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tell me about it!
Colt waits in the locker for three excruciating minutes then tumbles out...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hfff... `Hfff...` That's worse than the time Uncle Griz ate that spicy meatball pizza and used our bathroom!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hfff... [color=#e23b3b][i]Hfff...[/i][/color] That's worse than the time Uncle Griz ate that spicy meatball pizza and used our bathroom!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No... Can't distracted... Gotta stay... On target...
Colt staggers down the hall toward the office...
Colt throws open a classroom door and lunges inside...
And the Spartan guy walks by, oblivious!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hff... Hff... That was close...
Just then, there's the sound of something clattering at the other end of the room, from the closet! Colt approaches it cautiously and peeks inside...
Where Lee and Paige are making out, oblivious!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, Lee is a stone-cold player!
Leaving them to it, Colt sneaks back into the hallway. He crawls along the lockers and makes his way towards the office...
Colt hesitates for one terrified moment...
The Spartan guy gets closer! Colt spins around, panicked, and fumbles for a locker. He pulls open the door...
Colt creeps down the hall as quietly as he can...
When there's some sudden movement from down the hall! Colt can see the shadow of a Spartan guy rounding the corner!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh crap!
Colt spins around and hides in...
Colt drags himself furiously towards the school, getting closer and closer...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Almost there... `Almost there...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Almost there... [color=#e23b3b][i]Almost there...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt is nearly to the back door when suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...What is that clicking sound?
Colt spins around... And finds himself staring into the hollow, beady eyes of a honey badger!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh no... No no no...!

nodes.speaker: Badger
nodes.text: Hssssssssk!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No way... He recognized me! He's `back` for revenge!
nodes.text_bbcode: No way... He recognized me! He's [color=#e23b3b][i]back[/i][/color] for revenge!

nodes.text: The badger rears up, and his eyes glow red!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Demon! `DEMON!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Demon! [color=#e23b3b][i]DEMON![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt bursts out of the brush and hurls himself into the school through a window! The badger hisses loudly behind him!
Colt hits the ground hard and sprawls out on the tile floor!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hate that stupid honey badger! That thing is some kind of monster...
Outside, several Spartan guys rush out, investigating the disturbance...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not to mention way too noisy. I've got to move fast!
Colt takes a deep breath... Waits for the guard to turn his back...
Then sprints for it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, come `on!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, come [color=#e23b3b][i]on![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt dives through the building's back door, just in time!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...
Colt hesitates for a moment... The Spartan guy looks his way...
So Colt dives into the brush and starts crawling!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Phew... Close call...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, Tiny Hipster. But this is how it's got to be.
Late that night, Colt creeps on his belly through the brush...
Up ahead lies a big, empty, old school building.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look at that... While Denni and I were huddling in the mud and pulling bugs out of each others' hair, the Spartans were living large in Babytown Elementary!
A Spartan guy walks out and looks around. Colt ducks back down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I could try to crawl my way up through the bushes... Or I could rush the back door when the guy's back is turned...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no. Not `this` again. We've been over this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no. Not [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] again. We've been over this!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What can I say? I'm a predictable guy... And I'm not gonna let you put yourself in that kind of danger.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are you talking about? I've been with you this whole time, taking out one Spartan guy after another! I can `clearly` handle myself!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you talking about? I've been with you this whole time, taking out one Spartan guy after another! I can [color=#3b78e2][i]clearly[/i][/color] handle myself!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This isn't creeping through the brush, nabbing goons like Mark. This is a full-blown raid on their main base.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If this goes wrong, you're not just gonna catch a stray paintball to the arm. You're gonna get hit with a total paint barrage... Or worse.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know, I don't know how many times I have to tell you this, but I knew what I was getting into when I signed up.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm fine taking risks. I like them, even. And you don't get to tell me what to do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I mean, honestly. How would you like it if I told you what you could and couldn't do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's different. I mean... You're not supposed to protect me...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course I am. I'm your girlfriend. Protecting you is my job...
Denni gently presses her paintball gun to Colt's chest.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now either we're going down there together... Or I'm shooting you right here and now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You wouldn't!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Try me!
Colt stares Denni in the eye... And then turns around and starts walking.
Denni holds the gun up after him... But lowers it, unable to shoot.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're a great girl, Denni... But you're a terrible bluffer.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Please! There's got to be another way!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Tom's my best friend. That means I have to try and save him... But you? You're off the hook.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If I go down there and get taken out, then you can still go on and win the game!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But if we both get taken out... Well, we might as well buy some polish, because we're gonna spend the rest of high school shining Spartan shoes!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's... Actually a good point...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I know you're as stubborn as a mule and twice as tough. I `know` you can win this game, with or without me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I know you're as stubborn as a mule and twice as tough. I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] you can win this game, with or without me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now my friendship with Tom is worth risking my shot at the prize... But it's not worth risking yours.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold down the fort. I'll go down there and get him out. And if it goes wrong, and I get hit... Well... You win this thing for me, okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There's... There's got to be another way...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: There's an old abandoned school down by the south bank of the lake. That's where they're holed up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice! Thanks, Mark!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Wait... That's not all. They've got a hostage... A real VIP, if you ask me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who?
Mark's face twists into a sinister grin...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Tom Prince.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No... Fancypants wouldn't let a bunch of two-bit jokers like you capture him...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Heh... It was all Chad's idea. He set up a fake motorcycle trail leading through the woods... He knew Tom would think it was yours and follow it right into our trap!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Now they've got him all tied up and blindfolded in the Principal's office... Just waiting for the right moment to finish him off!
Colt's face darkens with anger. He clenches and unclenches his fists...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tom and I promised each other we'd meet up... We were gonna fight this out together...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...
Colt turns and stalks away. Denni rushes after him...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hey! What about me? Can I go now?
Colt freezes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You seriously think I'd honor a deal with a stooge like you?
Without turning around, Colt spins his gun back and shoots Mark directly in the chest with a paintball!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not a `Ghost` of a chance!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not a [color=#e23b3b][i]Ghost[/i][/color] of a chance!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh `nice!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh [color=#3b78e2][i]nice![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I've been working on that one for the last few minutes.
Colt and Denni walk to the edge of their camp, where Colt begins arming himself...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you think I'm doing? I'm going in to save Tom!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Into the heart of the Spartan camp? Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You got it. I'll sneak in at night under the cover of darkness... Take out any sentries one by one...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah? And what am I going to be doing this whole time?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Come on, Denni, don't make this harder than it has to be.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It means, I'm doing this mission solo.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no. No way. Absolutely not.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Princess...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't you Princess me! We agreed that we're in this together! That means `every` mission!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you Princess me! We agreed that we're in this together! That means [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] mission!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I'm not discussing this, okay? I can't let you go with me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What do you think we can offer him? You're not seriously going to suggest we split the prize money...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course not. We're gonna offer Mark the one thing he wants more than anything else... A little respect.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't follow...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Watch and learn, Princess. Watch and learn.
Colt walks over to Mark and hunkers down next to him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Mark. Can I call you Mark?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: What `else` would you call me?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#e23b3b][i]else[/i][/color] would you call me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let me level with you, Mark. I need to know about the other Spartans. And you're going to tell me about them.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Ha! And what are you gonna do if I don't? It's not like you can torture me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course not. I'm sure going through life as Mark Backbutter is torture enough.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's why I'm not going to talk about what we'll do if you `don't` talk...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's why I'm not going to talk about what we'll do if you [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] talk...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm going to talk about what we'll offer you if you `do.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm going to talk about what we'll offer you if you [color=#e23b3b][i]do.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: What are you talking about? What can you offer me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What you want more than anything else... A chance to be Spartan's big hero!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Which is truly shocking, I think we can all agree.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Heh!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What I'm saying, Mark, is let's say the Spartans wipe out all the Centerscore students. What then?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No wait, don't tell me... You're gonna take a dive and let Chad win!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: ...And? So what if that's true?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know thinking ahead's a little rough for you, but try with me for a second... What happens then? You go back to being exactly who you are: a sad, little stooge for the big Spartan fish.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But what if that's not how it went down? What if it was a nail-biting fight to the very end... And then you were the one who turned it all around and scored Spartan the win?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: You're offering to let me win the games?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course not. I'm just giving you another chance.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You tell me what the Spartans are up to, and I'll let you run out of here. I'll even give you a spare paintball gun. Then you can bide your time and wait until the moment's right...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And maybe... Just maybe... Be the big hero of the games.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you think of `that,` Backbutter?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you think of [color=#e23b3b][i]that,[/i][/color] Backbutter?

nodes.text: Mark thinks it over for a minute...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You sure that'll work? Mark's a lot of things, but I don't think he's easily intimidated...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And `I` think you're underestimating just how intimidating I can be!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] think you're underestimating just how intimidating I can be!

nodes.text: Colt spins around and walks over to Mark's chair, giving it a hard shove! Mark falls back onto the ground!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yo! Not cool!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, did the little baby tumble out of his itsy bitsy chair? Cry me a tiny violin!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I don't think that's the expression...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, lookie here! We've got ourselves a WordWizard!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Here's an expression you might not be as a familiar with...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Talk... Or `else.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Talk... Or [color=#e23b3b][i]else.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Or else `what,` huh? You're gonna shoot me? Go ahead! Shoot me! I don't care!
nodes.text_bbcode: Or else [color=#e23b3b][i]what,[/i][/color] huh? You're gonna shoot me? Go ahead! Shoot me! I don't care!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shoot you? Naw. Shooting you would be `way` too easy. We're gonna have some fun with you first.
nodes.text_bbcode: Shoot you? Naw. Shooting you would be [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too easy. We're gonna have some fun with you first.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Wha... What do you mean? You can't torture me! It's against the rules!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah? Well, do you know why I'm terrible at board games?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's because I `never` read the rules!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's because I [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] read the rules!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, hold on! Time out! Sorry, I hate to break up this increasingly scary thing you're doing, but... We're not actually going to torture him, are we?
Colt stands still for a moment, then turns and walks back to Denni. He speaks in an urgent whisper...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, of course not! I'm just bluffing!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh! Okay! Just wanted to make sure!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Did you seriously think I wasn't? What kind of a guy do you think I am?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You probably don't want me to answer that...

nodes.text: Why don't you ask your 14 missing Spartans how it worked out for them?

nodes.text: No! It... It can't be! Not you! It was a myth! A legend!

nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.text: There's a rumor going around about two mysterious Centerscore players who stalk the woods, picking off Spartans one-by-one!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: According to the rumor, they hunt in the shadows and creep through the darkness... They know no fear or hunger... And they mark every kill on their arms!

nodes.text: They call them... `The Ghost` and `The Hipster!`

nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.text: Wait, time out! You get to be The Ghost, and I'm still The Hipster? Why do I have to be The Hipster?

nodes.speaker: Colt

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Colt. It was a stray shot while we were running... I wasn't fast enough. I let you down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, it... It wasn't your fault...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I promise, Denni! I promise! I'll get them all for this! I'll get `them all!`

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Shut up, Tom.
Colt gently kisses Denni, then stands up and pumps his gun.
